tasks.label: Setup GraphPulse environment
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location 'C:\Users\suman\graphpulse-ai'; @('venv/', '__pycache__/', '.env', '*.png', '.DS_Store') | Set-Content -Path '.gitignore'; if (-not (Test-Path '.\venv\Scripts\python.exe')) { python -m venv venv }; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install graphifyy google-genai streamlit pydantic pytest requests; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip freeze | Out-File -Encoding utf8 requirements.txt; .\venv\Scripts\graphify.exe vscode install; .\venv\Scripts\graphify.exe install --project; git status --short --branch"

tasks.label: Commit GraphPulse setup
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location 'C:\Users\suman\graphpulse-ai'; git config user.name 'Copilot'; git config user.email 'copilot@users.noreply.github.com'; git add -A; git commit -m 'chore: configure local environment, dependencies, and Graphify VS Code skill' -m 'Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>'; git log -1 --oneline"
